qa_pairs.question: What kind of data is depicted in the 'Puissance utiliséEN.png' graph within the GPU jobs section of the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The 'Puissance utiliséEN.png' graph in the GPU jobs section depicts power consumption.

qa_pairs.question: Where in the Metrix portal can Alliance users find visual data on power consumption specifically for GPU jobs?
qa_pairs.answer: Alliance users can find visual data on power consumption for GPU jobs in the 'GPU jobs' section of the Metrix portal, represented by the graph labelled 'Puissance utiliséEN.png'.
